label: Bible Study
prompt: I go the way of all the earth: be thou _____ therefore, and shew thyself a man;
verse: I go the way of all the earth: be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man;
note: David's deathbed charge to young Solomon — 'be thou strong therefore, and shew thyself a man.'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful _____: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verse: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
note: The words every worker longs to hear: 'Well done' — and faithfulness in a few things leads into the master's joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he _____, and must be awaked.
verse: And it came to pass at noon, that Elijah mocked them, and said, Cry aloud: for he is a god; either he is talking, or he is pursuing, or he is in a journey, or peradventure he sleepeth, and must be awaked.
note: Elijah's taunt on Mount Carmel: shout louder — maybe Baal is busy, travelling, or 'peradventure he sleepeth.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: For ye are dead, and your life is _____ with Christ in God.
verse: For ye are dead, and your life is hid with Christ in God.
note: Your real life is in safekeeping — hidden with Christ, as secure as a deposit in heaven's vault.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He shall see of the _____ of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
verse: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities.
note: 'He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied' — birth-pain language for the harvest of the cross.
